strategies.name: Sequential 8-stage all-reduce baseline
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all_reduce operations with intermediate scale/unscale transformations between each stage, matching the reference implementation structure. Total 8 all_reduce dispatches with full W*S payload each. Represents the straightforward approach with maximum dispatch overhead but simplest logic.

strategies.name: Fused local-op batched all-reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all scale/unscale coefficients and fuses consecutive local operations (scaling loops) into vectorized operations before each all_reduce. Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but reduces kernel launch overhead by batching all per-shard operations into single tensor operations. Trades memory for fewer local-op dispatches.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter + all-gather pipeline
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all_reduce into reduce_scatter followed by all_gather, enabling 16 smaller collectives (8 pairs). Each reduce_scatter operates on S-sized chunks per rank, allowing potential overlap of computation and communication across stages. Higher dispatch count (16) but smaller per-dispatch payload and potential for pipeline parallelism.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction
strategies.desc: Exploits multi-node topology by performing intra-node all_reduce followed by inter-node all_reduce for each of the 8 stages, using 16 total collectives. Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by aggregating within nodes first. Beneficial when num_nodes > 1 and intra-node bandwidth significantly exceeds inter-node bandwidth.

strategies.name: Scale-factor pre-aggregation with 2-phase reduce
strategies.desc:
Observes that scales cycle every 5 ranks (a[r]=1.0+0.4*(r%5)). Groups ranks by scale value, performs 5 parallel reductions for each scale group across 8 stages, then combines. Uses all_reduce with custom reduction groups or all_to_all to separate and recombine scale groups, reducing redundant scale/unscale operations. Total ~13-16 dispatches depending on grouping strategy.
